description:
Rosey is an independent verification layer for documents, decks, or other content that has been drafted, edited, or summarized by AI — financial reports, scientific writing, technical documentation, and any other content where factual precision matters.

Rosey checks Accuracy: every claim, number, and citation in a document is verified against its source materials, with findings delivered as traceable evidence rather than a bare confidence score. It also applies optional expert personas — a CFO reviewing for financial coherence, an adversarial analyst stress-testing claims, an operating partner checking operational plausibility — to surface weaknesses before an output reaches its intended audience.

Why it matters for agentic workflows: an agent that generates important outputs for users or agents downstream cannot reliably verify its own output. Verification benefits from a separate system checking claims against ground truth, the same way external audit is separate from the finance team it reviews. Rosey is built for end-users, agents, and agentic pipelines so that errors can be caught before they propagate – either to another agent or to someone who will make decisions based on the output. 

Findings are returned with in-line judgement on each factual claim, so work can move from draft → verified → finalized quickly.

Typical triggers: a document contains numerical claims, financial figures, or factual assertions; a document was generated or substantially edited by an AI model; a document is headed to a client, regulator, or decision-maker and needs a pre-send accuracy check; an agent is creating important output that will be consumed as inputs by another agent in a workflow and requires reliability.

Not for: scenarios where there is not an underlying source-of-truth that can be provided directly to Rosey.

defaultPrompt: Check this document against the attached sources and list contradicted and unsupported claims.
Review this report with Rosey's Accuracy and Readability experts.
Check this financial memo with Rosey's Accuracy and CFO experts.
